text.hero.1: Version v0.15.3 · on your computerBeta · pre-release
text.hero.2:
Artificial intelligence,
running right on your computer.
text.hero.3: AIVN lets you download open-source language models and chat with them without an Internet connection or an account. Your data never leaves your computer. The new AIVN AGENT mode can also use tools on its own: read files, do calculations, write reports and send scheduled reminders.
text.hero.9: Free · Windows 10/11 64-bit · macOS 13 or later · At least 4 GB RAM (8 GB recommended) · GPU acceleration (Vulkan on Windows, Metal on Apple Silicon Macs)

text.tinh-nang.2: Everything you need to run AI locally
text.tinh-nang.3: No coding required. Open the app, pick a model and start asking. When you want more, every setting is right there.
text.tinh-nang.4: AIVN AGENT handles multi-step tasks New
text.tinh-nang.5: Give it a task and AIVN AGENT picks the tools: calculator, date and time, reading PDF/DOCX/CSV, writing files, running JavaScript in a sandbox (and Python if installed). Each step appears as a card showing the tool, its input and its result, and you can stop at any time. Everything runs on a local model; it works best with Qwen3 4B/8B or Gemma 3 4B and up.
text.tinh-nang.7: AIVN AGENT only reads and writes in folders you allow. Deleting or overwriting a file always needs your confirmation, and deleted files go to the Trash. Web search (DuckDuckGo, Wikipedia) only runs when you turn on “Allow network access”, and every address it opens is logged.
text.tinh-nang.9: Say “remember…” and AIVN AGENT keeps it for later conversations; the Memory page lets you view, edit and delete what it saved. Schedules send reminders or hand AIVN AGENT a task once, daily or weekly, with a system notification and a saved result. AIVN can keep running in the system tray.
text.tinh-nang.10: Discover: every GGUF on Hugging Face
text.tinh-nang.11: Search public GGUF repositories on Hugging Face directly, sorted by downloads, newest or likes, plus 29 pre-tested picks. AIVN suggests a Q4_K_M quantization, tells you whether a model fits your RAM and labels models with a vision projector as “Sees images”. Downloads are queued and can be paused and resumed.
text.tinh-nang.13: Paste an image with Ctrl+V / Cmd+V or drag it in, and vision models such as Qwen3-VL, Qwen2.5-VL, Gemma 3 4B or SmolVLM look at it directly: describe drawings, read charts, explain screenshots. AIVN downloads the vision projector (mmproj) for you and runs it with llama.cpp on your machine.
text.tinh-nang.15: Attach PDF, DOCX, TXT/MD/CSV or source code files (up to 20 MB). AIVN splits the document into chunks, searches them by meaning with the BGE-M3 model running locally, passes only the relevant chunks to the model and adds “Source: file, chunk n” under the answer. Follow-up questions don’t need the file again.
text.tinh-nang.17: Text-only models can still use images: AIVN reads the text in screenshots, exam timetables and receipts with on-device Vietnamese and English OCR, and clearly marks which part came from the image.
text.tinh-nang.19: History stays on your computer. Customize the system prompt, temperature and context length, stop an answer that runs too long, and copy answers with one click.
text.tinh-nang.21: Turn your computer into a local AI server: /v1/chat/completions (function calling with tools, JSON schema output, images for vision models), /v1/models and /v1/embeddings for your own search apps. Familiar client libraries work right away; just change the base URL.
text.tinh-nang.22: Makes the most of your hardware
text.tinh-nang.23: Uses your GPU automatically: Vulkan (NVIDIA, AMD, Intel) on Windows, Metal on Apple Silicon Macs. No GPU? It still runs on the CPU.
text.tinh-nang.25: A clean red-and-white design with Dark and Auto (follow the system) modes. Switching themes plays a smooth circular reveal, the app opens without a color flash, and you can choose how much animation you want.
text.tinh-nang.27: AIVN checks for a new version when it starts. On Windows, click Download and then Restart; on Mac, AIVN tells you about the update and opens the download page.
text.mo-hinh.2:
Thousands of open models.
Pick the one that fits your machine.
text.mo-hinh.3: The Discover page in AIVN finds every public GGUF repository on Hugging Face, with 29 pre-tested picks (Qwen3, Qwen3-VL, Gemma 3, Llama, Phi-4, Mistral, DeepSeek R1, gpt-oss, the Vietnamese-tuned VyLinh…). Here are a few, with their real download sizes.

text.mo-hinh.39: OpenAI’s open-weight MoE model with strong reasoning. Needs 16 GB RAM or more.
text.mo-hinh.42: * Downloaded directly from Hugging Face inside the app. RAM figures are approximate. Each model is subject to its publisher’s license; AIVN does not own or redistribute any model. Gated repositories require your Hugging Face access token, which is stored only on your computer. Models labeled “Sees images” are downloaded with their vision projector (mmproj); on Windows, vision mode needs the Microsoft Visual C++ Redistributable 2015–2022 (AIVN will guide you if it is missing).

right on localhost

text.rieng-tu.3: Every question, attachment and chat history is processed and stored on your own computer. AIVN never sends your content to any server, including ours.
text.rieng-tu.4: 🔒 No cloudModels run locally, no connection needed.
text.rieng-tu.5: 🙈 No trackingYour chats and files are never collected.
text.rieng-tu.6: ✈️ Works offlineOn a plane, in the countryside, or when the Wi-Fi is down.
text.rieng-tu.7: 🗂️ You’re in controlDelete chats and memories or switch models at any time. AIVN AGENT only goes online when you allow it.
text.faq.2: My computer is low-end or has two GPUs. Will it work?+
text.faq.3: Yes. Since version 0.14.0, AIVN detects your GPU (NVIDIA, AMD, Intel, Apple), counts only the dedicated VRAM of the discrete GPU on dual-GPU laptops, chooses how many layers to offload and steps down automatically (fewer layers → smaller context → CPU) if loading fails. The Discover page shows Runs well / Runs slowly / Not enough memory for your machine and suggests a suitable model.
text.faq.5: Yes. AIVN is free for personal and educational use. The models you download are subject to their publishers’ licenses.
text.faq.6: What are the system requirements?+
text.faq.7: Windows 10/11 64-bit or macOS 13 or later (Apple Silicon or Intel) and at least 4 GB RAM (8 GB or more recommended). The app takes about 0.8 GB, plus the models: from 0.5 GB for small models to 5–12 GB for 7B–20B models, and another 0.6 GB if you use BGE-M3 document search. AIVN shows how well each download fits your machine. A Vulkan-capable graphics card (Windows) or an Apple M-series chip makes answers faster but is not required.
text.faq.8: Does it really work without the Internet?+
text.faq.9: Yes. You only need a connection to download the app and models and to check for updates. Chat, AIVN AGENT (except web search, if you enable it), Memory, Schedules, image understanding, document reading and search, OCR and the API server all work offline.
text.faq.10: How is AIVN AGENT different from normal chat, and is it safe?+
text.faq.11: In AIVN AGENT mode the model can use tools: calculate, check the date and time, read and write files, run short JavaScript snippets in a sandbox, remember things, create reminders and search the web if you allow it. AIVN AGENT only sees the folders you add in its settings. It must ask before deleting or overwriting a file, and you can say no; deleted files go to the Trash. Network access is off by default, and scheduled runs can never delete or overwrite files. Small models (under roughly 3–4 billion parameters) often call the wrong tool, so AIVN warns you; Qwen3 4B/8B or Gemma 3 4B and up are recommended. On a CPU-only machine, a multi-step task can take about a minute.
text.faq.12: Do schedules run when AIVN is closed?+
text.faq.13: Schedules run while AIVN is open. Turn on “minimize to tray when closing the window” to keep AIVN running in the background, and “start with the computer” to launch it when you sign in. A reminder missed within the last 6 hours (for example while the computer was asleep) runs as soon as AIVN reopens. Notifications use the Windows/macOS notification system.
text.faq.14: Do the models understand Vietnamese?+
text.faq.15: Yes, to varying degrees. Qwen2.5 1.5B/3B, Qwen3 4B and Arcee VyLinh 3B (fine-tuned for Vietnamese) handle Vietnamese quite well. More powerful computers can use Qwen2.5 7B or Qwen3 8B. Very small models (0.5–0.6B) are fast but often wrong.
text.faq.16: What file types can I attach?+
text.faq.17: PDFs with a text layer (text you can select), DOCX, TXT, MD, CSV, JSON, common source code files and PNG/JPG/WEBP/GIF/BMP images, up to 20 MB per file and 5 files at a time. For long documents, if you download the BGE-M3 search model (~605 MB, once), AIVN splits the document into chunks of about 500 tokens, finds the chunks most relevant to each question and cites “Source: file, chunk n” under the answer; the index is stored per conversation on your computer. Without BGE-M3, AIVN falls back to keyword search. Multi-page scanned PDFs and old .doc files are not supported yet.
text.faq.18: Can AIVN see and understand images?+
text.faq.19: Yes, with models labeled “Sees images” (Qwen3-VL 2B, Qwen2.5-VL 3B, Gemma 3 4B, SmolVLM 500M, or any GGUF with an mmproj file in the Discover). With such a model loaded, pasted images go straight to the model and AIVN notes “The model sees the image directly”. With a text-only model, AIVN reads the text in the image with OCR, passes it to the model and says so clearly. Small vision models running on the CPU are slower and sometimes less accurate. On Windows, vision mode needs the Microsoft Visual C++ Redistributable 2015–2022 (x64); if it is missing, AIVN opens Microsoft’s official download page.
text.faq.20: Which models can I download?+
text.faq.21: Any public GGUF repository on Hugging Face whose architecture is supported by the llama.cpp engine in AIVN (Qwen2.5, Qwen3, Gemma 2/3, Llama 3.x, Phi-3/4, Mistral, DeepSeek R1 Distill, gpt-oss…). AIVN merges split files (-00001-of-0000N) into one model, downloads the vision projector (mmproj) for vision models, hides files that are not chat models and warns you if an architecture is not supported. For gated repositories, enter your Hugging Face access token in the Discover; it is stored only on your computer.
text.faq.23: When it starts, AIVN checks for a new version (Internet required). On Windows, click “Download” and then “Restart to update”; no manual reinstall needed. On Mac, because the Mac build is not yet signed by Apple, AIVN tells you about the update and opens the download page so you can replace the app.
text.faq.24: Can I use AIVN in my programming projects?+
text.faq.25: Yes. Turn on the API server in AIVN, then point your app to http://localhost:1234/v1 as you would with any OpenAI-compatible service.

text.dl.19: Opening AIVN on a Mac for the first time? See how
text.dl.20:
🔒 Opening AIVN on a Mac for the first time (the app is not notarized by Apple)
  1. Open the downloaded .zip (Safari usually unzips it for you), then drag AIVN into your Applications folder.
  2. Open AIVN. If macOS says it can’t verify AIVN, click Done (not Move to Trash).
  3. Open System Settings › Privacy & Security, scroll down to Security, click Open Anyway next to the message about AIVN, enter your Mac password, then click Open Anyway again.
  4. On macOS 13 and 14 there is a shortcut: in Applications, right-click (or Control-click) AIVN, choose Open, then click Open. From macOS 15 this no longer works, so use step 3.
You only need to do this once. If macOS says “AIVN is damaged”, open Terminal, run xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/AIVN.app, then open AIVN again.
